test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: After deducing a commission of 20%, a DVD set costs ₹9,080. Its marked price is:
solution:
**Given:**

Final cost after 20% commission deducted = ₹9,080

Commission rate = 20%

**Formula to use:**

Final Price = Marked Price - (Commission Rate × Marked Price)

**Solution:**

⇒ 9080 = MP - (0.2 × MP)

⇒ 9080 = MP(1 - 0.2)

⇒ 9080 = MP × 0.8

⇒ MP = 9080/0.8 

⇒ MP = 11350

**The marked price is ₹11,350.**
